name: Circa Energy
old_description: Produce your own electricity by going solar with Circa Energy.
about:
Based in Annapolis, Maryland, Circa Energy is a family-owned solar installation company led by owner Chip and chief operating officer Elena. The firm has been serving the region since at least 2019, focusing on residential photovoltaic projects and offering a turnkey experience that covers every regulatory step.

The company provides full-service solar installation, handling permit acquisition, inspection coordination, and the physical installation of panels and microinverters. All project phases are managed in-house, from initial design through final commissioning, with no subcontracting of core installation work.

Circa Energy primarily serves homeowners in the Annapolis area seeking to reduce electricity costs and gain energy predictability. Customer reviews highlight complex roof configurations, emergency repair work after storm damage, and projects requiring coordination with utility rebate deadlines as examples of projects the team has completed.

The company emphasizes a personal, transparent approach, with the owners directly involved in customer communication and problem resolution. Clients cite the firm's willingness to address warranty issues beyond contractual obligations, its ability to meet aggressive timelines, and the continuity of having the same points of contact throughout the project lifecycle as key differentiators.
